notes.title: Game Update Highlights: Performance Boosts, New Skip Card, and More!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're back with another update. Thank you for your valuable feedback; it's been incredibly helpful. We apologise for the delay in getting this update out to you; with our limited resources, progress has been slower than we initially planned.

[h2]Performance[/h2]
One of the most significant improvements in recent weeks has been focused on performance fixes. We still have plenty of room for improvement, but we've managed to address some issues, particularly noticeable on the larger islands. However, you will likely experience improvements on smaller islands with lower-end configurations as well.

[h2]Skip Card & Skip Card Plus[/h2]
Based on your feedback, we've made changes to the operation of the Skip card. Starting now, when you use this card, you won't receive an extra step at the end of the season in place of the skipped tile. Instead, we've introduced a new card called Skip Plus, which works just like the old Skip, skipping the next tile and granting you an extra step.

[h2]Ships and Orcas[/h2]
The number of ships and orcas has been limited to a maximum of 6 on the map. This change is part of an ongoing development where active ships and orcas on the map will disappear if they couldn't move anywhere during the current season.

[h2]Mixed Tiles[/h2]
We've removed mixed tiles from the "Eternal Autumn" mode as they were causing severe imbalances in gameplay. This change will affect existing maps with mixed tiles since they will no longer load.

[h2]Others[/h2]
Furthermore, we've addressed a few minor bugs in the user interface, fixed some localization issues and made some game balances.

We wish everyone a fantastic gaming experience and appreciate your support in shaping our work!

notes.title: Message of Thanks and Game Updates from Glasscannon Team
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Island Architects!
[/h1]
First of all, we would like to express our immense gratitude to all of you for supporting our small team and trying out our game. A special round of applause to everyone who provided feedback and bug reports. These things help us refine the game further.

We were delighted to see that the game ran smoothly for most of you, with relatively few reported bugs. Among these, we have addressed the most critical ones in the first round.
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Free Spot bug: In certain cases, free spots did not appear in specific positions even though they should have. Fixed.
[*] Incorrect tile height display: After extended gameplay, there were instances where the displayed tile heights deviated from their actual values. Fixed.
[*] Camera error: The camera did not track changes in sea level height, causing it to look underwater if the sea level rose significantly from its original position. Fixed.
[*] AMD setups: Some players experienced game freezes at startup with AMD setups. Fixed.
[/list]
[h2]Balance & Game Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ships and whales now provide only 1 point per move instead of 3.
[*] Free spots will now be visible in positions where the current tile cannot be placed due to neighboring tiles. In such cases, an X will be visible on these free spots.
[*] In the coming period, we will continue to work on fixing smaller bugs and balancing the game. Additionally, we are actively developing controller support. Good news for Steam Deck owners: our team will receive a Steam Deck in October, and we will immediately start working on Steam Deck support.
[/list]

[b]Cheers!
Glasscannon Team[/b]

notes.title: The FREE Prologue Version of Land Above Sea Below Released!
notes.content:
[b]We're thrilled to announce that the Land Above Sea Below FREE Prologue version is finally out![/b]  One of the most important things is that with this step, we've completed the game's demo. Huge thanks to everyone who tried it out and provided us with feedback. We warmly welcome your thoughts about the game (or anything else, of course :) ).

In the prologue version, we've made some major changes to the gameplay to make it more balanced and, of course, fixed a bunch of bugs.

[h2]Tree of Falls[/h2]
One of the most significant changes involved the Tree of Fall mechanism. So far, there was one type of ToF in the game that could synergize with all basic types. That has changed now. Each basic type has its own ToF, which can only synergize with the corresponding biomes. We've created separate action cards for each ToF. But getting extra ToFs isn't just limited to cards. From now on, you can also find ToFs on bonus islands, so by unlocking them, you not only gain a bunch of extra points but also access to extra seasons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/99b9839389acdec256dc380582ea1fea60dc951b.png[/img]

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]
We've made some adjustments to the tutorial to make the game clearer for you. We still don't want a long, boring, and hand-holding tutorial, so we'll only show you the basics. For everything else, there's the lexicon, which we continuously expand and improve based on your feedback.

[h2]Stat View[/h2]
We've added extra stats that the game tracks, which you can see not only at the end of the game but also during gameplay if you open the lexicon in the pause menu. Here, the game displays your highest scores achieved so far and other data, such as the number of unlocked bonus islands, completed mini-objectives, placed tiles, the height of the tallest tile, and the number of seasons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/c6acaec0826078f649dcdd18b369ca06a8b7c14c.png[/img]

[h2]Game End[/h2]
Furthermore, at the end of the game, by clicking on the "Show Island" option, you'll have the chance to revisit your islands and move the camera around to find the best composition or even create a video of it. The statistics are also shown here.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
Achievements have been added, at least the first set. You won't be able to complete these in the prologue version, but you can check out the challenges we have in store for the full version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/37b942cd4435926ec682d3b1618206bae0365a1d.png[/img]

[b]The 1.0 version arrives soon! We're incredibly excited about all of this, so once again, a massive thank you for all the positive and constructive feedback you've given us so far![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/85fa3e2511a25429ce89438b7f5ec06ba46efd4d.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest is back and we're here with a brand new demo
notes.content:
[h1]Hey Island Architects![/h1]

[b]Steam Next Fest is back[/b], and we're here with a brand new demo and some other fantastic news! The new build has many new features and updates, and we are sure you will love it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/fd3673be510244c4892fdc14cbe4378ed6b10e00.jpg[/img]

Our small team of 4 people at [b]Glasscannon Studio[/b] have been working hard over the last few months to bring you Land Above Sea Below as quickly and as fun as possible. It's been a very exciting time for us, and it's only going to get more exciting as we get closer to the release later this summer!
[h2]Watch the new game trailer to get hooked![/h2]
[previewyoutube=i2rpJR7LEkk;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Here are the new features in the demo[/h2]
[list]
[*] brand new, simple, and quick to complete tutorial to help you learn the basics
[*] new tile types
[*] more sophisticated scoring system
[*] skill cards that give you more options for keeping your Tree of Fall above water, so you can build bigger and more diverse islands
[*] you can now see in the UI how many moves you have left in the season and what type of tile you will receive
[*] improved graphics
[*] unique weather system
[*] new music and sound effects
[*] lexicon/help menu where you can find rules and unlocked tiles
[*] new end screen where you can see some useful statistics (this will be expanded in the future)
[*] random reefs to diversify the gameplay and the island you build
[*] updated and balanced synergy system
[*] mini-objectives - simple tasks that can be completed to get extra steps in the season
[*] performance improvements, balance and lots of bugfixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/fd28bdb106b838a695d731d02dd04d329696821b.jpg[/img]
[h2]Added to the full version in the meantime[/h2]
[list]
[*] sandbox mode - build islands without restrictions, only your imagination will be the limit
[*] save/load system - start a new island at any time or reload an existing one and continue. And you can load failed games into sandbox mode at any time to enjoy or even modify them.
[*] achievements - challenges that you can complete to refine your strategy
[*] no season cap so it's up to you how big your island is and how long the game lasts
[/list]

[b]Of course, we don't want to stop here, and we have a lot of ideas and content to implement, but we will need you to help us do this in the future. We couldn't have made it this far without you and all the ideas, advice, and feedback we've received from you![/b]
[h2]And here's another great piece of news![/h2]
Somewhere around the beginning of the year, we were found by [b]Skystone Games[/b], who saw the potential in our game and took us on! This great team is helping us to do what they are really good at, to bring Land Above Sea Below to as large an audience as possible.

We are also very honoured to have [b]David Brevik[/b], President of Skystone Games (the father of the Diablo franchise), to help us polish the gameplay and provide us with his professional advice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/85fa3e2511a25429ce89438b7f5ec06ba46efd4d.png[/img]

If you want to be part of the development and help us or just chat with us, join our [url=https://discord.gg/gNhjNWxqnx]Discord[/url] server!
Have a great week, and try out as many awesome demos as you can during Steam Next Fest!

[b]Cheers,
Glasscannon and Skystone Team[/b]

notes.title: BIG DEMO UPDATE is HERE!
notes.content:
[h1]Autumn is here again[/h1]
[h3]...so are we with lots of news, and with a major update![/h3]

Our team has expanded to 4 people, we're now working with a graphics designer and a composer together.

We plan to release the game in early access as soon as possible - we would be happy if it could happen this year.

We implemented a lot of major and minor tweaks and changes, to make the game even more fun to play.

[h2]Update Notes[/h2]
[h3]Reworked Score System[/h3]
We have rethought the score system and instead of showing the score for each tile one by one, we instead write the total score above the newly placed tile. In addition, by taking into account all the tiles involved and the level of synergy, we have introduced extra multipliers so that it is much better and clearer to see if a tile has been placed in a really good position.

[h3]Island Extension System[/h3]
As you progress in expanding your island and exploring undiscovered areas on the map, you might bump into lonely, tiny islands. If you connect your main island to them, these islands (its tiles) will be attached to your land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/48ac0c440d7e7d2a6b637aba4fd2efb600ae833b.png[/img]

[h3]Reworked Ingame UI[/h3]
Based on your feedback, we thought the game's UI was not intuitive enough and did not serve you well enough to understand the rules. So we scrapped the entire interface and developed a new one that we hope will make the gameplay clearer and smoother for everyone. You can see the synergies more clearly on the new interface, and the highlighting of the touch tiles has also become clearer. New icons and color coding have been implemented for each tile type. The interface of the objective system has been rethought and with it its functionality. Skill cards have been added, but this feature is still very much under development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/a7ee5076825a4b3218ed430d94074ef8353f1174.png[/img]

[h3]Reward System & Skill Cards[/h3]
We discarded the previously parallel objective/reward system and developed a simplified linear system instead. As you score more points you get a sequence of skill cards. You will see the next 3 rewards and their corresponding score on the interface.

To acquire them, you need to earn a certain score point, which is always shown on the screen. Once the required score points are reached, you will automatically be awarded with one card. These cards then can be played out anytime throughout the game, as long as you have at least one of them in your hands. These are the different skill cards in the game:

[list]
[*] [b] Decrease water level:[/b] The water level will be immediately decreased by one unit.
[*] [b]+1 step in the season:[/b] You will get one extra step before the end of the season.
[*] [b]Skip tile:[/b] You will skip your current tile that needs to be placed.
[*] [b]Special tile:[/b] You will get a new special tile that can be placed on the map
[*] [b]Up:[/b] All Tree of Fall tiles will raise their height by 1 unit
[*] [b]New life:[/b] You will get a new Tree of Fall that can be placed on the map
[/list]

This feature is a very work-in-progress one, we waiting for your feedback to polish it.

[h3]Visual Upgrades[/h3]
Changes have also been made in the visual field. The game got a completely new sea effect/shader, we tried to adjust it so that the coastline is more clearly defined.
We've also tweaked the postprocessing effects a lot to give you a clearer picture.

[h3]Save game function[/h3]
The game automatically saves the last state of your island and reloads it upon launching it again, so you can continue building your dream island where you left it before.

[h3]Upgraded Steam Page[/h3]
With so many new features and changes, it was time to update the game's Steam page with new descriptions, screenshots and graphics. And while we're at it, we also got a new logo and key art.

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[i]This version does not yet contain a tutorial, but we have collected the most important information in a useful short guide. But we will be back soon with a completely new and polished in-game tutorial.[/i]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/660de4408f5749834ba9e3f04ab3fdd37e49b852.png[/img]

If you haven't already, [b]join our discord server[/b] for more work-in-progress information and first-hand updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/7d54fe3789a6ce1d5591406cb7ca650c7590c9da.png[/img]

[u][b]So try out the new demo, give us feedback and share your island with us on discord! Stay tuned, we will be back soon, in the meantime, enjoy the autumn![/b][/u]

notes.title: News and updates
notes.content:
[b]After a long silence, we report back. The development has not stopped, in fact there are many new additions to the game and more importantly to the team! We have added a graphic designer and a composer in the last month.[/b]

[previewyoutube=EF-ifaPJQ_c;full][/previewyoutube]

Without being exhaustive, the following things have been added to the game:

[list]
[*] completely new and much more intuitive UI
[*] island extension system
[*] long-term objectives
[*] new highlight system
[*] new water shader for the sea4
[*] visual upgrade
[*] plus animations
[*] much more balance
[/list]

The demo version has not been updated yet. Our plan is to make an early access version as soon as possible. We will update the demo in parallel.

notes.title: Demo Update Note #5
notes.content:
[b]Hello there! First of all, we'd like to thank all of you who have tried the game and even more for all the helpful and encouraging feedback you've given us. You guys are awesome![/b]

We've brought you some new improvements and bug fixes.

[h2]Feature list[/h2]

[list]
[*] season-o-meter now indicates the last move and the game shows you which tiles are at 0 meters on the last move
[*] new tile types will now be unlocked according to the number of tiles placed, and by the played seasons
[*] river tile types now keep adjacent tiles above water level, if they are from the same type
[*] while moving the camera, the game now does not allow you to accidentally place tiles
[*] resolution setting implemented in the options menu
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] fixed the bug when the height of the special tile types did not raise
[*] the mismatch between tile highlighting and the actual affected tiles involved has been fixed
[*] season-o-meter UI bug fixes
[/list]

[b][u]We are looking forward to meeting you at our [url=https://discord.gg/gNhjNWxqnx]Discord [/url]server as well![/u][/b]

notes.title: Demo Update Note #3
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone, we can't be grateful enough for all the feedback we receive from you. One of them, perhaps the most important, was how we could make even better use of the rotating of the tiles. With this update, amongst others, we deliver mixed tiles to you, where it really matters, how you rotate them.[/b]
[h2]New tile type - mixed environment[/h2]
[list]
[*] The same rules apply to this tile as to the others, but it will consist different base tiles, thus it will be important, how You rotate it before laying it down
[*] The mixed tile is generated from the already unlocked tile types
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/cffe0b53b6977c74de9bb10552e64650be7b1c0e.png[/img]
[h2]Game Balance[/h2]
[list]
[*] New tile types are unlocked earlier
[*] The unlockable tile types are based on how many seasons you played, not on the number of the already placed tiles
[/list]
[h2]Tiles[/h2]
[list]
[*] We have changed the colors of the tiles so that the mixed tiles can be matched easily
[/list]
[h2]Season cap[/h2]
[list]
[*] The duration of the demo is now depending on the seasons that you have played, instead of the tiles that you have placed
[/list]

[i]The update contains some performance and minor bug fixes too.[/i]

[i][b]Make sure that you try out these new features, and leave your comments and thoughts! We are looking forward to meeting you at our Discord server as well![/b][/i]

notes.title: Demo Update Note #2
notes.content:
With this update, we bring you more challenges, as you will have to place the tiles more carefully, to prevent your island from getting flooded.
[h2]Game Rules[/h2]
[list]
[*] to affect the tile height, you'll need to place 3 similar tiles next to each other, instead of 2.
[*] to get an extra round during the season, you'll need to place 4 similar tiles next to each other, instead of 3.
[*] to decrease the season-o-meter, you'll need to place 5 similar tiles next to each other, instead of 4.
[/list]
[h2]Options menu[/h2]
[list]
[*] implemented an option to turn on or off the automatic tile info.
[*] when it's turned off, the info can still be seen by pressing the left ALT.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/9eaa66165044ff4504d15da845815e1651bc779d.png[/img]

[h2]Long term tasks[/h2]
[list]
[*] these tasks can be completed throughout the whole game.
[*] if you reach the desired score, the achievements of the tasks will be unlocked.
[*] the score meter will be re-set, and a new, higher score goal will be set.
[*] completing any of the long-term tasks, the season-o meter resets
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/4cdd4177d8e823a1bdc458c569fbfc7bee3dcea3.png[/img]

[b]Currently available long-term tasks in the demo version:[/b]

[list]
[*] new tree of fall - by completing this task, you'll be able to place a new main tile with the tree of fall on it - thus increasing your survival chances. In case, your first tree of fall is inescapably sinking, this will provide you with a second life.
[*] decrease water level - by completing this task, the sea level will decrease by one unit, and you will get back the recently sunken tiles.
[/list]

[h2]Others[/h2]
[list]
[*] minor UI changes
[*] fixed some performance issues
[/list]

[*] new tree of fall - by completing this task, you'll be able to place a new main tile with the tree of fall on it - thus increasing your survival chances. In case, your first tree of fall is inescapably sinking, this will provide you with a second life.
[*] decrease water level - by completing this task, the sea level will decrease by one unit, and you will get back the recently sunken tiles.

notes.title: Demo Update Note #1
notes.content:
[b]Hi Guys, we are so glad that you are all here, and that so many of you have tried out our game already.[/b]

We really appreciate all the feedback that we've got from you in recent days. It means a lot to us! On one hand, it confirms that we are on a good path, and on the other hand, it is our nr. 1. resource list for improvements and further developments. 

If you didn't do it until now, you are warmly welcome at our [url=https://discord.gg/gNhjNWxqnx]Discord server[/url], to have a chat with fellow gamers, or with us. 

We will be looking forward to your further feedback on the game.
Stay with us in our journey, and put us on your wishlist to see from the first row how we develop this game together!

[h2]Demo Update 0.2.08052022[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/5c75001efae57ce5b0291c88527e5cebd6c9f5c6.png[/img]

[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] a small change in how the new tile appears. Important features are now highlighted.**
[*] a new UI feature that shows how much a new tile fits another, it shows information about its height and type.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/f1385056a5c878b8e217fb1f55c2cfc48ba97ef2.png[/img]

[b]Color Coding Implemented For Tile Placement[/b]
[list]
[*] green: fits 100%, you get the max points
[*] orange: it fits partially, the placement will have some effects on the adjacent tiles
[*] white: it doesn't fit, there will be no extra effects
[*] red: the neighboring tile has already sunk
[*] no icon: there is no relevant information, e.g. there are no effects for the adjacent tiles when placing ships
[/list]

[i]This information is also available at an already placed tile by hovering the mouse over it.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42157699/048118a4efebe9ba7c4e5cc9306c121050c422cc.png[/img]

[b]Score Points[/b]
[list]
[*] default score point changed from 10 to 5
[*] the length of a river has an effect when placing river tiles. After every connected river element, you will get an extra 15 points
[/list]

[b]Score Color Coding[/b]
[list]
[*] white: normal score
[*] purple: rare score - you did something great!
[*] red: epic score - you did something amazing!
[/list]
	

[h2]Leaderboard[/h2]
[list]
[*] we implemented the steam leaderboard system
[*] the leaderboard will be re-set after every update, as the balancing, new rules, and new implementations can affect the achievable score, and difficulty.
[/list]

[h2]Trees[/h2]
[list]
[*] we implemented the wind! - Which blows the trees, so you can see them swaying in the wind
[/list]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
[list]
[*] changed the tile rotating audio effects
[*] added score event audio effect
[/list]
